sections.overview: This Afrotropical hairstreak butterfly is one of two recognized species in the small West African genus Dapidodigma.
sections.identification: In males, its pale androconial patch lies above the hindwing cell, unlike the patch centered on the cell in D. hymen.
sections.habitat: The specialist review records it from forest and contrasts this with D. hymen, also reported from dry woodland and scrub.
sections.diet: Larval food records include Homalium; an Albizia record was published under D. hymen, so the host evidence is limited.
sections.behavior: The genus is reported to have ant-attended larvae and pupae.
sections.reproduction: The cited genus review gives no species-specific developmental calendar.
sections.ecology: D. hymen is its only listed congener in this two-species genus; see that profile for comparison.
sections.conservation: No global conservation assessment was located in the sources reviewed.
